This section will list confirmed conference presentations, posters, symposia, and other academic presentations, including event names, dates, authorship, and links to shareable materials when available.

### Submitted Proposals

Submitted proposals that have not yet been accepted may be listed separately and clearly identified as *submitted* rather than *accepted* or *presented*.
